name: Neo Geo Pocket
description: SNK's first handheld, released in Japan in October 1998 with a monochrome screen. It was soon overshadowed by the Neo Geo Pocket Color, released only months later, so it had a short life and a small library. Its clicky microswitch stick was praised for fighting games.

specs.cpu: Toshiba TLCS-900H @ 6.144 MHz + Zilog Z80 @ 3.072 MHz (sound)

curiosities: It was replaced by the Neo Geo Pocket Color only about five months after launch.
Most later Neo Geo Pocket Color games still run on the monochrome model.
It has a built-in clock, calendar and horoscope features in its system menu.
The monochrome model was never sold in North America or Europe.
bestsellers: King of Fighters R-1: Pocket Fighting Series
story: SNK released the original Neo Geo Pocket in Japan in 1998 with a black-and-white screen.
It was replaced only months later by a colour version.
It is now a rare piece of handheld history.
